per_question.question: How do I make a web link open a specific screen in my Android app?
per_question.answer:
Add an intent‑filter to your AndroidManifest.xml that verifies your web domain and handles the URL scheme, for example:

```xml
<intent-filter android:autoVerify="true">

    <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
    <category android:name="android.intent.category.BROWSABLE" />
    <data android:scheme="http" android:host="example.com" />
    <data android:scheme="https" />
</intent-filter>
```
Then define a matching route in Flutter (e.g., with GoRouter) that maps the path `details` to the desired screen:
```dart
GoRoute(
  path: 'details',
  builder: (_, __) => const DetailsScreen(),
),
```
When a user clicks a link such as `http://example.com/details`, Android will launch the app and the router will display the Details screen. You can test the setup with `adb shell 'am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -c android.intent.category.BROWSABLE -d "http://example.com/details" <package>'`.
